title: Quarter Load Amount of the OTC Allowance (Benefit Accounting Rule)
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, over-the-counter allowance ledger.** Each quarter load is booked on the member's pharmacy coverage as one amount.

**Rule.** The quarter load is the plan's quarterly allowance — the quarterly OTC allowance amount of the member's PrairieRx plan. The quarter load is booked in dollars and cents, and only the quarter load is rounded to the cent.

### Rule broken down

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Which figure is loaded? | The plan's quarterly OTC allowance amount |
| On which record? | The member's pharmacy coverage, as one load entry for the quarter |
| Rounding | Only the quarter load, to the cent |

### Worked figures (hypothetical plans)

| Hypothetical plan quarterly allowance | Quarter load |
|---|---|
| $35.00 | $35.00 |
| $25.00 | $25.00 |
